steps.reasoning: Search recursively for electricity-named files first; if paths do not carry that label, enumerate files and retain receipt-like candidates so selection remains data-driven.
steps.action_code:
electricity_file_paths = apis.file_system.show_directory(access_token=file_system_access_token, directory_path="/", substring="electricity", entry_type="files", recursive=True)
if electricity_file_paths:
    all_file_paths = list(electricity_file_paths)
    receipt_candidate_paths = list(dict.fromkeys(electricity_file_paths))
else:
    all_file_paths = apis.file_system.show_directory(access_token=file_system_access_token, directory_path="/", entry_type="files", recursive=True)
    path_keywords = ("electric", "power", "utility", "bill", "receipt")
    receipt_candidate_paths = [path for path in all_file_paths if any(keyword in str(path).lower() for keyword in path_keywords)]
    if not receipt_candidate_paths:
        receipt_candidate_paths = list(all_file_paths)
receipt_candidate_paths = list(dict.fromkeys(receipt_candidate_paths))
print({"candidate_paths": receipt_candidate_paths})
verification_targets: Complete recursive set of plausible receipt paths

steps.reasoning: Every plausible receipt candidate must be read before choosing a billing period or amount; printing these public file records grounds the subsequent selection.
steps.action_code:
receipt_file_records = []
for receipt_path in receipt_candidate_paths:
    receipt_file_records.append(apis.file_system.show_file(file_path=receipt_path, access_token=file_system_access_token))
print([{"file_id": record.get("file_id"), "path": record.get("path"), "content": record.get("content"), "created_at": record.get("created_at"), "updated_at": record.get("updated_at")} for record in receipt_file_records])
